abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel and Alvenor reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Cardivel and Alvenor reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 6. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.
